activity.notes: Elizabeth II acceded to the British throne on 6 February 1952 immediately upon the death of George VI and remained Queen of the United Kingdom until her death on 8 September 2022. ATLAS records only the United Kingdom kingship relation here rather than duplicating her separate Commonwealth-realm crowns.
